🌧️ Level 3: Rain Dey Come!

“Rain Dey Come!” = Rain is coming! Take Aunty Kemi's clothes in before the rain!

▶ Play Level 3 free

What happens

Dark clouds are rolling in and Aunty Kemi's washing is still on the line. Tap all six clothes before the rain arrives. Be quick: thunder is coming!

What players practise

  • Quick tapping and reaction time
  • Beating a gentle timer

Pidgin lines from this level

Aunty Kemi

No problem — try again!
Aunty Kemi
You fast pass lightning! ⚡
You're faster than lightning!

Did you know?

"Rain dey come!" is Pidgin for "Rain is coming!" — the warning shout that sends a whole compound running for the laundry.

When you win

“You beat the rain! Aunty Kemi's clothes are dry.”
